objective: Reconcile final v0.24.9 observed acceptance with every binding PRD section/criterion; distinguish contract coverage from a universal absence-of-bugs claim.
method: Exact observed Rust test result names matched from completed exact-source canonical job, not inferred from a suite exit code. Existing named trace reviewed against unchanged sections1-36 and AC01-23; added publication/causal regressions included. No new source edits, tests, live provider calls or release.

limitations: Named requirement/test coverage is not proof of universal absence of bugs.
Provider-neutral synthetic repair fixtures do not establish every live model account will correctly code arbitrary repairs.
Historical controlled public red/green and outage fixtures retain their scope; no new deliberate external failure was induced on final source.
Original Windows10 laptop execution is unexecuted and distinct from RRC contract coverage.
No separate delegated independent reviewer was launched.
